qas.question: who is shubman gill?
qas.answer: Shubman Gill (born 8 September 1999) is an Indian international cricketer who plays for the national team across all formats . He is the captain in the Test format and the vice-captain in the ODI format. He's the #1 ODI batter in the rankings as of May 2025. He captains Gujarat Titans in the Indian Premier League and plays for Punjab in domestic cricket. A right-handed top-order batter , he made his international debut in January 2019 against New Zealand. Gill was a part of the 2025 Champions Trophy champion team.
